name: PTI Engineered Plastics
old_description: By cutting out the middle man, we cut costs and leadtimes. PTI was founded on tool making, so you can be confident that your part will be manufactured to the highest standards.
about:
PTI Engineered Plastics operates from a 160,000-square-foot facility in Macomb, Michigan. The privately held company was founded in 1984 as Proto-Tech Industries, producing functional prototype molds and injection-molded samples before adopting its current name in 1987 to reflect a turnkey, mind-to-manufacturing model.

The company combines in-house toolmaking with scientific injection molding to produce plastic components and assemblies for low to higher volumes, up to 100,000 units or more annually. Its capabilities span cleanroom molding in over 10,000 square feet of ISO Class 8 space, insert and over molding, high-temperature molding, prototyping, and value-added services such as ultrasonic welding, EMI shielding, pad printing, laser marking, assembly, and packaging. A dedicated tool-transfer program helps customers revive existing tooling.

PTI serves medical, defense/aerospace, consumer, industrial, and electronic OEMs. Its quality system supports IQ/OQ/PQ process validation and PPAP submissions, and the facility includes 5,000 square feet of controlled environment for assembly and packaging.

Founded on tool making to eliminate middlemen and reduce cost and lead time, PTI emphasizes a 360-degree collaboration process with customers, from design-for-manufacturability through full-scale production. The company maintains ISO 9001, ISO 13485, MedAccred, ITAR, and FDA registrations.
